counting_rules: Each primary run artifact counted once; summaries/reviews of the same run are not extra questions.
Count includes unsuccessful and withheld application responses.
Targeted reruns, probes, incomplete pilots, earlier29-query set, source checks, browser tests and offline replay checks are excluded from this conservative coverage total.
Unique text is normalized with NFKC and casefold, not unique religious topics.
Historical runs used changing app versions and criteria; cumulative volume is not current-version accuracy.
limitations: No claim that all365 questions passed or were rerun on the final version.
No measured search-popularity ranking or independent scholarly certification.
